title: catpart-export output, schema v1
description: Version-1 summary emitted by `catpart-export <file>` on success (ticket #32), alongside the binary little-endian PLY it writes. The summary describes the decoded CATStdCont nested-store geometry (docs/evidence/2026-11-09-nested-store.md G1, 2026-11-09-vertex-pool.md G2, 2026-11-09-facet-semantics.md G3): the vertex pool in walk order, the triangles decoded under G3's pinned primitive semantics (0x4a/0x42 triangle strips with the alternating flip and phase reset per loop, 0x4c closed polygons fan-triangulated from the first corner, lexicographic-rank references, CCW winding preserved as decoded). Failure is not a summary: classified errors exit nonzero with an error_class JSON line on stderr (missing-geometry-store / undecoded-variant / malformed-*). Evolution is additive within a schema version: consumers must ignore properties they do not know.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Bumped only by a breaking output change; additive changes keep the version.

vertex_count.description: Number of PLY vertices: the decoded pool (all 01 06 pool groups flattened in body order, G2 P1g/P2g; 15-byte records [05 08 01][f32le xyz]).

triangle_count.description: Number of PLY faces: the decoded triangles after G3's degenerate-skip convention (F7). 0 for a vertices-only export (the G2 P7 pool-without-connectivity family, warning class no-facet-records).

min.description: Pool coordinate minimum per axis (x, y, z).

max.description: Pool coordinate maximum per axis (x, y, z).

bounding_box.description: The pool's coordinate extents (G2 P10: every pool-carrying part has a non-degenerate bbox).

class.description: Warning class. unresolved-facet-family: facet records of families whose primitive reading G3 has not pinned (0x41/0x44/0x49/0x4b/0x4e, open questions 3-5) and/or unparseable header candidates; where such records produce in-pool loops they still decode under the structural strip reading (G3's soup convention). degenerate-triangles-skipped: the G3 F7 skip convention fired (0 on every clean-store soup). open-shell: the mesh is a manifold with boundary edges (G3 F6's sheet-like open shells, legitimate geometry). unused-pool-vertices: pool positions no triangle references. no-facet-records: pool without any facet header candidate (G2 P7), exported vertices-only. curve-entry-loops-unexported: composite loops referencing skip slots (curve entries) — their coordinates live in the curve records (U4, open, stage-3d #34 2026-11-11) so those loops are not exported; the store's other loops export.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation citing the evidence claim.

warnings.description: Non-fatal decode observations, in a fixed order (degenerate-triangles-skipped, no-facet-records, open-shell, unused-pool-vertices, unresolved-facet-family). Empty on a fully clean decode.

store_ordinal.description: 0-based ordinal of the exported block among the blocks of the container family the store was located in (CATStdCont blocks for stores the shipped law located; the stage-3a probe family's blocks for recovered stores). With several blocks, the first store passing the export gate wins.

container.description: Container family whose region located the store (stage 3a #34): stdcont = the shipped CATStdCont law, xdoclink = a CATXDocLinkCont region probe, seebody = a CATSeeBodyCont region probe (G1 N10's next_block_store family and the seebody stores, docs/evidence/2026-11-10-l2-grind-classification.md section 6).

tail_law.description: Catalog-tail law that validated the store (stage 3a #34): shipped = the pre-stage-3a window [cb, origin + dword8 + dword12); overshoot = the G1 C3 dword8-overshoot variant, read from the true catalog magic with length dword12; padded = the G1 padded-tail variant, ended at its CB__END (N4w).

store_recovery.description: Present only on recovered stores (stage 3a #34, the L5 lever): how the store was located — which container probe and which catalog-tail law. Absent on stores located by the shipped CATStdCont law. A recovered store that then fails the decode names the same probe/law on the error detail instead.

origin_kind.description: G1's store-origin variant: v5header for the 32-byte V5_CFV2 header variant (N1h, 1,056/1,173), block for the header-less variant (N1l, origin = block start, 12 R19 parts).

pool_group_count.description: Number of decoded 01 06 pool groups in the store body (G2 P1g). The pool is flattened across groups in body order, G3's soup convention.

facet_candidate_count.description: Number of facet header candidates (the 01 [41-4f] . ff regex positions) in the store body.

facet_record_count.description: Number of facet records accepted by the (width, k) tiling law (G3 F1/F1w).

degenerate_triangle_count.description: Degenerate strip triangles skipped at decode (repeated vertex or zero cross product, G3 F7; 0 on every clean-store soup).

edge_count.description: Distinct undirected edges of the decoded triangles.

manifold.description: No edge used more than twice (G3 F6: 76/76 clean-store soups). Vacuously true at 0 faces.

closed.description: Every edge used exactly twice (G3 F6: 66/76 clean-store soups; false marks the sheet-like open shells, warning class open-shell). Vacuously true at 0 faces.

oriented.description: Each edge used once per direction (G3 F6: 66/66 of the closed soups; the winding law F5 preserved). Vacuously true at 0 faces.

boundary_edge_count.description: Edges used exactly once (0 on closed solids).

mesh.description: Mesh invariants over the decoded triangles (G3 soup_stats measures).

composite.description: Additive composite-only decode block (stage-2c/3d #34; present only on composite-space exports — consumers ignore unknown properties). Carries the identity decode counters (stage, element_decl, node_points, curve_entries, write_count, table_bytes, facet_candidates, facet_records, skipped_markers, loops_exported, loops_curve_entry) and, on multi-rep stores (stage identity-per-rep, the stage-4b per-rep law), reps_decoded / reps_exported / reps_unexported / rep_reasons. node_bytes (stage-5 fold-in, 2026-11-12, docs/agents/stage-3d-reconciliation.md section 5): the decoded list-node payload byte span(s) — the single list node's payload on single-rep stores (stage identity-table-walk), the sum of the scanned node payload spans on multi-rep stores; over 4096 B marks the big-form family, letting form be derived from summaries/CSVs.
